channel.title: Eleanor Toye Scott — Writing

item.title: So the river has rights - so what?
item.description: Recognising the rights of the River Cam is encouraging. Protecting them in practice means confronting water scarcity and the pressures of development.

item.title: My Father and the Chancellor’s Toilet
item.description: How an impossible request from a Treasury martinet sparked a legendary memo — and an early exit from the Civil Service.
